summary: Timeline editing and preview UI over Project Asset projections and Remotion components.
context_hints: InteractiveCanvas.tsx is the only InteractiveCanvas implementation and public export.
Timeline UI may consume Host-projected URLs but must never turn storage keys into /api/assets/view routes.
Poster, waveform, and filmstrip state is frontend-derived, scoped, bounded, disposable device cache state and never synchronized Timeline facts or Durable output.

key_files.src/components/ui/controls.tsx: Native editor controls. RemotionNumberInput keeps incomplete numeric drafts out of Timeline facts; keyframe fields reset drafts when the item or playhead changes.
key_files.src/components/timeline/TimelineItem.tsx: Timeline item presentation and ephemeral editor-only caches.
key_files.src/components/timeline/TimelineTracksCo: Keeps all lane shells for scroll/drop geometry; IntersectionObserver releases distant clip controls with overscan while retaining selected and dragged content.
key_files.src/components/timeline/waveformCache.ts: Bounded LRU/TTL cache for device-derived Timeline waveform samples.
key_files.src/components/timeline/items/renderers/: Image Timeline renderer over projected media URLs.
key_files.src/components/FontFamilyPicker.tsx: User-initiated Local Font Access picker over installed families, shared by text and captions. The family name persists in Timeline; font bytes are not embedded or synchronized.
